passage.label: let man observe what created; created fluid ejected; emerging between backbone ribs; Indeed Allah return him life Able; Day secrets put trial; then man no power any helper

arabicExcerpts.text: فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٖ وَلَا نَاصِرٖ

mainSubject.label: Man directed to observe his own origin — created from an ejected fluid emerging from between the backbone and the ribs — establishing that Allah is able to return him to life; on the Day when secrets are put on trial he will possess neither power nor any helper

subordinateSubjects.label: Man directed to observe the substance of his creation
He was created from an ejected fluid
Emerging from between the backbone and the ribs
Allah affirmed able to return him to life
The Day when secrets will be put on trial
On that Day man possessing neither power nor any helper

commandsAndProhibitions.description: So let man observe from what he was created.

humanConditionsAndSpiritualStates.label: Human origin traced to an ejected fluid between backbone and ribs
Secrets put on trial leaving man without power or helper

relationships.label: Origination from fluid offered as proof of ability to restore life

notes: Wave 12 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the universal-protector declaration (4) before the creation-observation command opens (5); P2 ends with the no-power-no-helper verdict (10) before the second oath pair begins (11); P3 runs through the decisive-statement affirmation, the mutual plotting and the closing respite instruction (11-17).
